policy: At most one technical repair per condition, performed by its original author agent; no aesthetic correction of benchmark variants

harnessChanges: After first B: explicit Blender python exit code and diagnostic-only surface-quality reporting; no relaxed gates or changed geometry/render settings
timingLimit: CPU wall times observed on a shared host, including validation. Some baseline runs overlapped brief diagnostic probes and browser use. Not model inference latency or a controlled speed ranking.
